// diagnostic E0218

Jet.PinWithoutWriteWindow

`mem.pin` needs a named place to pin.

What

`mem.pin` needs a named place to pin.

Why

A pin promises one storage location will not move, so it has to name that location instead of a temporary value.

Fix

Bind the value to a `^` name, then write `mem.pin(place)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.PinWithoutWriteWindow: Tests/UI/pin_needs_write_window.stderr.

    |                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A pin promises one storage location will not move, so it has to name that location instead of a temporary value
 Fix: Bind the value to a changeable name, then write `mem.pin(place)`
